brief: Petrol-teal drench, ten years outlined in structural slab, the next experiment solid and glowing saffron.
rationale:
The phrase is a plant-your-feet credo lifted straight from Doug's own words about Spaceman: ten years running his own shop, already building the next small thing. On a Monday when the market fell 3.6% and the headlines are caregiving costs and a dead reality star and layoff-adjacent AI talk, the steadiest true thing is Doug's decade. So the page is drenched in a deep petrol teal, a cool committed field that reads as stillness, not noise. The composition is a full-bleed statement: the credo is the single h1, broken into two beats, the decade outlined like a frame already filled, the next experiment solid and glowing saffron. That is the one place color turns on, and it lands only on what is actually live and forward.

Zilla Slab carries it because the catalog's structural-civic-grounded voice is exactly the register of "ten years independent": a sturdy slab says built, not shouted. It shipped once two weeks ago in a completely different treatment (dark-void, lower-case, vertical), so today's drenched caps outline is a genuine new use, and it keeps me off the three condensed-caps chassis and off the three recently-avoided faces. The twelve-column grid lets the marquee run full-bleed while the day's signals pack the cells below as size-marked specimen furniture, so the page is dense and committed rather than a centered stack with one poster line.

The palette is one dominant hue at volume with a single warm pulse, the gold-standard committed gesture. Petrol teal 187° sits in the open slot just past the mandate's self-contradictory forbidden edge, distinct from the recent fairway and teal greens, and cool drench fits the day's mood. Saffron marks the RSM Classic in progress and the forward clause, nothing else, so the accent stays rare and load-bearing. The brand mark folds into the hero top-left, white disc carrying on the deep teal in dark and the mono mark stepping in for the pale light scheme, inside the first fold at both widths.

hero.copy: Ten years independent. Still the vehicle for the next experiment.
hero.rationale:
Lifted from Doug's own voice file, where he describes Spaceman as "the LLC I've worked under for ten years" and "still the vehicle for the next experiment." On a Monday when SPY dropped 3.6% and the news is all noise and caregiving and layoffs-adjacent anxiety, the steadiest true thing on the page is that Doug has run his own shop for a decade and is already building the next small thing (FishSticks, 15th Club, the one after). It beats another design/build credo because the recent run already fished that theme three times; this one is about endurance and forward motion, not the gap. It beats the Aristotle quote because that line elevates teaching over doing, and Doug is a doer who builds the things he wants to exist, so the quote would be a poster of Aristotle, not of him.
Owner's voice: Doug literally wrote this line about Spaceman; ten years, one vehicle, next experiment, no hype.

adBrief.selfCheck:
1. Hero quotability: Yes — "Ten years independent. Still the vehicle for the next experiment." is a standalone credo, not a descriptive opener.
2. Because-of chain: Yes — endurance credo → drenched still field + broken two-weight statement → structural slab (Zilla) → petrol-teal cool for stillness, saffron for the live/forward beat.
3. Render feasibility: Yes — Zilla hero clamps to 112px at 1440 (under its 120px ceiling), line two drops to 3xl; no overflow at full-bleed.
4. Canvas floor feasible: Yes — dense signal furniture plus a full-bleed marquee statement and footer data strip genuinely fill 82%.
5. Phone: Yes — at 360 the caps line wraps "TEN YEARS / INDEPENDENT" at 3xl inside the first fold without cutting a word.

adBrief.compositionRationale: I kept the mandate's horizontal/dense/syncopated/folded-into-hero/drenched/statement because a two-beat credo on a committed field is exactly that read. I moved columns off `three` to `irregular-twelve` so the marquee statement can run full-bleed while the day's signals pack the cells below as size-marked specimen furniture (three newspaper columns would chop a 112px caps line). I moved symmetry off `symmetric` to `broken` so line one (outlined decade) and line two (solid saffron future) carry different weight and position, and I moved collapse off `hero-only` to `reorder` so the dense furniture survives at 360 instead of vanishing below an isolated hero. hero_zone went to `full-bleed` because a drench wants the type filling the field, not floating centered with clearance.

colorScheme.color_story: A deep petrol-teal floods the field for ten still years against a loud Monday, and one saffron pulse marks the one thing still live and forward: the next experiment.

header.nav: Folded into the hero's top row on the petrol-teal field. Stacked-lg lockup (mark over "Doug March") top-left, original colours in dark where the white disc carries, mono mark in light. Top-right, one running lower-case line sets the three links inline (the work, the person, a way in), work/about/contact underlined in saffron. Mark sits inside the first fold at 1440 and 360.

verdicts.feedback:
1. (Judgment 5) The holes-in-one count is wrong in two places. The "Also today" cell says "Holes in one — 2, and counting" and the footer says "Golf — two holes in one." The record (`personal.holesInOne`) is 4. Set both to four.

2. (Judgment 5) Two experiment descriptions contradict the records. "TeeTurn — Experiment — tee-time logistics" is wrong: the record describes a mobile-first golf app for tracking a round's progress in real time, with Doug responsible for product direction and strategy. "Twittertale — Experiment — stories, 140 at a time" is also wrong: the record says it scanned public tweets for swear words and ranked the biggest potty mouths. Rewrite both from the records.

3. (Judgment 5) Two claims about Doug do not appear in the records. The footer says "Based — Detroit, Michigan," but no location is recorded. The Spaceman card says "Not a studio with a payroll and a committee," and the records say nothing about Spaceman's staffing; they say "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team." Cut both, or replace them with record language.

4. (Judgment 1) Tonight reruns 2026-11-19 almost axis for axis. Both nights use irregular-twelve / horizontal / broken / full-bleed / dense / syncopated / drenched / reorder on a drench ground, with heavy roman outlined caps as the hero register. That is the same silhouette and the same type register, not one shared trait. Break at least one of these: move the statement off the full-bleed band, or change the lead or texture so the outlined-caps drench does not read as the brass desk-plate night in teal.

The saffron line also runs inline after "INDEPENDENT." instead of sitting below it, as the Mobile Declaration's `first_fold` requires. 1. (Judgment 1) This reads as a rerun of 2026-11-19. Both nights use the same layout silhouette: irregular-twelve, horizontal, broken, full-bleed, dense, syncopated, drenched, reorder. Both also use the same type register: caps, roman, heavy, outline slab across a drenched field. A returning visitor would see the brass desk-plate night recoloured teal. Keep the phrase and the hue, but break one of these two. For example, drop the outline for a solid or stacked treatment, or move off the full-bleed twelve-column drench to a different silhouette.

2. (Judgment 3) Line two is declared as solid saffron caps, the forward clause glowing in the accent. It is rendered as dark type in a filled saffron box. That box becomes the heaviest mass on the page and outweighs the hollow outlined line one at both widths. Set "STILL THE VEHICLE FOR THE NEXT EXPERIMENT." as saffron-coloured type directly on the teal, with no box.

3. (Judgment 3) The type treatment declares `alignment: centred`, but the hero does not centre at 1440. "INDEPENDENT." starts at the left padding and the line-two box hangs off its right end, so the statement reads as left-weighted with a sticker rather than centred. Centre both lines within the field, as the 360 version already does.

1. (Judgment 3) The Type Treatment declares `texture: outline`. At both 1440 and 360, "TEN YEARS INDEPENDENT." renders as solid filled near-white caps. Set line one with a transparent fill and a `text`-coloured stroke, so the outlined decade sits against the solid saffron second line as the brief's two-beat intends.

2. (Judgment 5) The selected-work row reads "FishSticks — SaaS — the product in build". The record gives FishSticks status "Live", with thousands of kids practicing daily. Replace the descriptor with one that matches the live product, for example spelling practice from the list sent home.

measurables.method: Measured at 1440x900 on a 20px grid over the viewport at scroll position zero. canvas_utilization: % of grid cells touched by an element carrying designed content (visible text, an image/SVG/video/canvas, a background colour distinct from the page background and not transparent, or a background image such as a gradient). A background set on html or body counts as painting the page, unless it is opaque white; ::before and ::after boxes count on the same terms. color_coverage: % of grid cells whose sampled background, background-image stops or text colour is chromatic (HSL saturation > 12%, lightness 8-92%). hero_px: the largest computed font-size among first-fold elements that set visible text.
